omitted: Modal overlay lifecycle is not represented by inline confirmation fixtures.
SVG graphics, decorative images and pseudo-elements require separate visual review.
CSS sampling covers supported solid, generated PNG and vertical linear backgrounds; unsupported paint is explicitly unqualified.
Physical devices, assistive technologies, hosted login and actual background execution remain unqualified.
primaryTargetRule: 44 pixels for marked primary actions, default-size filled controls and navigation links; auxiliary small controls remain separately reviewed.
